findings.message: Read the hook payload from stdin. Claude Code supplies command-hook input on stdin, but the configured command passes no arguments. Consequently, `process.argv[2]` is absent, `input` becomes `{}`, and every invocation exits before checking shutdown requests. Read stdin and add a test using the configured invocation; the current tests pass JSON as an argument and miss this failure.

Resolve the recipient's branch instead of the sender's. When the team lead runs on `main` and an implementer works in an isolated worktree, this command resolves the lead's branch, so the subsequent `main` exemption permits shutdown without checking the implementer's reviews. On another feature branch, it checks unrelated evidence instead. Resolve the target agent's worktree and branch before checking evidence; separate implementation branches are explicitly required by [CLAUDE.md:23–24](CLAUDE.md#L23-L24).

Match review metadata rather than requiring branch filenames. Existing review sidecars use `<agent>--<file-content-hash>.json`, as specified in ADR-029 and consumed by `dev-team-review-gate.js`. A valid hash-named sidecar is therefore rejected here even when its JSON `branch` matches, preventing shutdown after review. Conversely, a filename containing a longer, unrelated branch name can satisfy this substring check. Parse sidecars and validate their branch metadata, consistent with the merge gate.
